DROPS E31: @mechanikalk co-founder and CTO of @QuaiNetwork: Proof of Work Is Not Dead

We dive deep into why 99% of crypto has drifted from the original cypherpunk ethos, how proof-of-work is far from dead, and why building for your mom might be the real key to global adoption.

We talk about:
- Why most of crypto is "irredeemable" and how we get back to true P2P electronic cash
- The "energy dollar" - Qi - and how tying money to electricity could preserve purchasing power
- SOAP: Quai’s merge-mining flywheel designed to capture hash rate and bootstrap growth
- Why the future of digital money comes down to freedom vs. control
- Why Bitcoin is digital gold but behaves like a tech stock

And much more….

François Chollet says there is always a tradeoff between intelligence and knowledge.

More operational knowledge means you need less intelligence to be competent.

Coding agents can now verify their own outputs and simulate code execution.

The capability is real.

But the need for intelligence shows up less and less.
